description: Golden cases for .claude/skills/test-strategy. Each case names a change to sample-app; the plan must cover the listed categories, reference the real existing tests, and surface the listed risks. facts[] records what reading (and, where marked, running) the code shows, so a grader can check the plan by hand.
matching: requiredCategories: at least one test case per category. mustReferenceTests: exact TestClass#method strings that must appear. mustMention: each term (or one of a list of alternatives), case-insensitive. minCases / minFindings: row counts.
